title: 第47章 制服持刀的疯女人

第47章 制服持刀的疯女人-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

“可是你已经退伍了……”

“退伍了也是兵。”

林国强把缠好抹布的手举起来看了看，攥了攥拳头，松紧合适，“素梅，你信我，我能处理好。”

赵素梅咬着嘴唇，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒地掉，但手慢慢松开了。

她知道拦不住他。

这个男人，性格执拗的很。

“你……你小心。”她哽咽着说，“你要是敢受伤回来，我跟你没完。”

林国强笑了，伸手擦掉她脸上的眼泪：“知道了。”

他转身走到门口，拉开半扇卷帘门，侧身钻了出去。

赵志军在后面喊了一声：“三姐夫！”

林国强没回头。

“你……你小心啊！”

林国强摆了摆手，头也没回。

卷帘门在他身后“哗啦”一声拉了下来。

街上的人少了很多。

能跑的都跑了，跑不动的惊恐地瞪大眼睛，腿脚发软，瑟瑟发抖。

地上到处都是东西。

菜筐、自行车、棉鞋、围巾、一个摔碎了的搪瓷茶缸、一地的白菜叶子。

那个被砍伤的男人已经被人拖走了，地上留下一大摊血，在阳光下闪着刺目的光。

周红站在街中间，手里握着那把菜刀，刀上的血已经干了，变成暗褐色的污渍。

她的头微微歪着，像是在听什么声音，又像是什么都没在听。

她的嘴里发出含混不清的嘟囔声，像是说话，又像是唱歌，谁也听不清她在说什么。

林国强站在国强小吃门口，看着她。

他深吸了一口气，然后慢慢地朝她走过去。

他的脚步不快不慢，跟平时走路一样。

手上缠着湿抹布，攥成拳头，贴在身体两侧。

他的眼睛一直盯着周红手里的那把刀，一刻也没有离开。

“大姐。”他喊了一声，声音不大，但很清晰。

周红没有反应，还是那样歪着头，嘴里嘟囔着什么。

“大姐，你把刀放下。”

林国强又喊了一声，往前走了一步。

"But you have already retired from the army..."

"You are still a soldier after you retire."

Lin Guoqiang raised his hand wrapped in a rag and looked at it. He clenched his fist and tightened it appropriately. "Su Mei, trust me, I can handle it."

Zhao Sumei bit her lip, tears falling down, but her hands slowly relaxed.

She knew she couldn't stop him.

This man has a very stubborn character.

"You... be careful." She choked and said, "If you dare to come back injured, I will never finish with you."

Lin Guoqiang smiled and reached out to wipe the tears from her face: "I know."

He turned around and walked to the door, opened half of the rolling shutter door, and got out sideways.

Zhao Zhijun shouted from behind: "Third brother-in-law!"

Lin Guoqiang did not look back.

"You...be careful!"

Lin Guoqiang waved his hand without looking back.

The rolling shutter door closed behind him with a clatter.

There are a lot fewer people on the streets.

Those who could run ran away, and those who couldn't ran widened their eyes in horror, their legs and feet were weak and trembling.

There were things everywhere on the ground.

Vegetable baskets, bicycles, cotton shoes, scarves, a broken enamel tea jar, and cabbage leaves on the ground.

The man who had been slashed had been dragged away, leaving a large pool of blood on the ground, shining dazzlingly in the sun.

Zhou Hong stood in the middle of the street, holding the kitchen knife in her hand. The blood on the knife had dried and turned into a dark brown stain.

Her head was tilted slightly, as if she was listening to something, but also as if she wasn't listening to anything.

There was an indistinct mumbling sound coming from her mouth, which sounded like talking or singing, and no one could make out what she was saying.

Lin Guoqiang stood at the door of Guoqiang Snacks and looked at her.

He took a deep breath and slowly walked towards her.

His steps were neither fast nor slow, just like normal walking.

There was a wet rag wrapped around his hands, clenched into fists and attached to his sides.

His eyes were fixed on the knife in Zhou Hong's hand, and he never left it for a moment.

"Sister." He shouted, his voice was not loud but clear.

Zhou Hong didn't respond, she still tilted her head and muttered something.

"Sister, put the knife down."

Lin Guoqiang shouted again and took a step forward.
